name: Unconfirmed features probe
description: What is left unconfirmed, plus the settled features kept in place so one save keeps working. CONFIRMED 2026-10-12: stat_curve (Sonic speed x10 read Speed +20 on the level-up screen and 27 at level 2 - creature base 7 + (90 - 70), so the table holds increments, not stats); pp_curve (PP 20/20 at level 1); store_stock (three late-game items appended to Store1 all appeared in Central City's Buying list at 1 ring, with the equip preview reading Attack +4 off the Nocturne Blade's own .ITM table). STILL OPEN - movement_slots, and the question has changed. Fly written into Sonic's EMPTY slot 2 did not work, while the player reports a build where Shadow was given Fly in his OCCUPIED slot 2 (vanilla Teleport) and crossed a Green Hill fly point playing his teleport animation - the ability worked, only the performance stayed positional, which is exactly the rule already confirmed for POW moves (a move's animation, minigame and hit count stay with the combo.GDA slot while the data is replaced). New hypothesis: an occupied movement slot can be REWRITTEN, an empty one cannot be FILLED, because the animation is addressed per character per slot index and Sonic has no slot-2 movement animation to play. This build moves exactly one thing to test it - Fly goes into Sonic's slot 1, which vanilla occupies with Dash, and Sonic's slot 2 returns to its vanilla -1 so the failing case is not re-run. Amy gets Fly in her slot 2, also vanilla-occupied (Dash), as a second independent reading. Outcomes fixed in advance: BOTH fly = occupied slots can be rewritten and empty ones cannot be filled, so movement_slots ships as a replace-only feature; SONIC ONLY = only slot 1 is read from creatures.GDA; NEITHER = the creature row's ability id is not what grants a movement ability on a fresh run, and Shadow's Fly came from the whole-row swap rather than from column 20. Control: Tails is in the party and has Fly natively, so Tails crossing the same gap separates 'the ability is broken' from 'that spot is not a fly point'. xp_rate 3 is a convenience only.
